title.en: And Now My Work Is Done: The Last Lines of the Metamorphoses
title.zh: 如今我已完成：《变形记》的最后几行

edition.en: Book XV, lines 871–879, as given on Latin Wikisource; checked against Hugo Magnus's edition (Gotha, 1892) in the Perseus Digital Library, which differs only in writing siquid for si quid.
edition.zh: 第十五卷第 871—879 行，据拉丁文维基文库；并与珀尔修斯数字图书馆所收雨果·马格努斯校本（哥达，1892 年）核对，两本只有 si quid 写作 siquid 的差别。

basis.en: Completed about 8 CE; Ovid died about 17 CE.
basis.zh: 约完成于公元 8 年，奥维德约卒于公元 17 年。

note.en: Ovid ends fifteen books of transformations with nine lines claiming that this one thing will not change: the poem will outlast fire, iron and time, and he will be read wherever Rome's power reaches. It is the younger sister of Horace's ode on this shelf, written a generation later and finished about the time Ovid was sent into exile. The claim has held better than he could have known: the poem is read in languages and places Rome never reached.
note.zh: 奥维德用十五卷写尽万物的变形，最后用九行诗宣告只有一样东西不会改变：这部诗将比烈火、刀剑和时间更长久，凡是罗马权力所及之处，都会有人读他。它是本书架上贺拉斯那首颂诗的妹妹，晚了一代人，大约在奥维德被放逐的时候完成。这番宣告比他所能想到的更为灵验：如今读这部诗的，有许多是罗马从未到过的地方、从未听过的语言。

excerpt.orig: Iamque opus exegi, quod nec Iovis ira nec ignis / nec poterit ferrum nec edax abolere vetustas.
excerpt.en: And now I have finished a work that neither Jupiter's anger nor fire nor iron nor gnawing age will be able to destroy.
excerpt.zh: 如今我已完成一部作品，无论朱庇特的怒火、烈火，还是刀剑、吞噬一切的岁月，都不能将它毁灭。

gloss.en: The anger of Jupiter: often read as a veiled reference to Augustus, who banished Ovid to the Black Sea in 8 CE.
gloss.zh: 朱庇特的怒火：常被解读为暗指奥古斯都；公元 8 年，奥古斯都把奥维德放逐到黑海之滨。

gloss.en: Gnawing, devouring: the same word Ovid uses earlier in Book XV, tempus edax rerum, 'time, the devourer of things'.
gloss.zh: 吞噬的。奥维德在第十五卷前面说过 tempus edax rerum：“时间，万物的吞噬者”。

gloss.en: Vates: poet and prophet at once, the word Augustan poets preferred for themselves.
gloss.zh: vates：既是诗人，也是先知；奥古斯都时代的诗人喜欢这样自称。
